settings.heading: Ladies Who Launch Season 4
settings.subheading: Your next big opportunity might be sitting in this room.
settings.copy:
What if one conversation could lead to your next collaboration, business opportunity, mentor, or even a lifelong friendship?

That’s the magic of Ladies Who Launch.

Now in its fourth season, Ladies Who Launch brings together 100 women who are building businesses, pursuing big ideas, navigating careers, and figuring things out along the way.

Whether you’re an entrepreneur, founder, creative, professional, or simply ready for your next chapter, there’s a seat for you.

This isn’t your typical networking event.

Expect honest conversations, inspiring stories, practical business lessons, and opportunities to connect with women you might never have met otherwise.

Because sometimes, being in the right room changes everything.

settings.title: Inspiring Talks & Real Conversations
settings.text: Hear from incredible women who have built businesses, overcome challenges, navigated criticism, and learned valuable lessons along the way. No sugarcoating, just honest conversations and experiences worth sharing.

settings.title: Meaningful Networking
settings.text: Meet potential collaborators, business partners, mentors, clients, and new friends. We’ve created opportunities to make connections that go beyond exchanging Instagram handles.

settings.title: Conversations That Don’t Happen Anywhere Else
settings.text: From business challenges and difficult decisions to personal growth and navigating setbacks, we’re opening up conversations that women don’t always get to have.

settings.title: A Curated Gift Bag
settings.text: Every attendee takes home a gift bag filled with goodies and surprises from our partner brands!

settings.title: Exciting Raffle Prizes
settings.text: Get a chance to win **Sunlight Air tickets**, a **TECNO smartphone**, and many more exciting prizes!

settings.title: Food & Drinks
settings.text: Enjoy food and refreshments throughout the event while connecting with our community.

settings.heading: Coming Alone? You’re Not the Only One!
settings.copy:
You don’t need to bring a friend to belong in this room.

Some of the best connections begin when you show up somewhere new, introduce yourself, and discover how much you have in common with the women around you.

Come as you are. We’ll help make the introductions easier. ❤️

settings.label: Location
settings.value: Greyhound Café, Ayala Triangle Gardens, Makati City

settings.heading: One Day. 100 Women. Endless Possibilities.
settings.copy:
You never know who you’ll meet, what you’ll learn, or which conversation might open your next door.

Come for the conversations. Leave with connections that could change your journey.

Seats are limited.
